417:         self.ffi, self.functions, self.structs = original.ffi, original.functions, original.structs
418:         self.originals = dict(self.functions)

433:     def _interrupted_call(self, name, args):
434:         # Passive instrument-local identities; no new call, target or authority.
435:         port = self.interrupted_port
436:         if ROLE != "controller" or port is None or port._interrupted_probe is None:
437:             return None
438:         native = port._interrupted_probe.native
439:         if native is None or not args:
440:             return None
441:         assert type(native) is FLOW._InterruptedNativeBinding and native.port is port
442:         named = (("server", native.server), ("client", native.client),
443:                  ("process", native.process), ("thread", native.thread), ("job", native.job))
444:         named += tuple(("member" + str(i), handle) for i, handle in enumerate(native.members))
445:         matches = [(label, handle) for label, handle in named
446:                    if handle is not None and not handle.closed and handle.value == args[0]]
447:         relevant = {"TerminateJobObject": "job", "WaitForSingleObject": "process",
448:                     "GetProcessTimes": "process", "GetExitCodeProcess": "process",
449:                     "QueryInformationJobObject": "job"}
450:         if name not in relevant and name != "CloseHandle":
451:             return None
452:         if not matches or (name in relevant and matches[0][0] != relevant[name]):
453:             return None
454:         assert len(matches) == 1 and len(self.interrupted_events) < 64
455:         label, handle = matches[0]
456:         assert not handle.unconfirmed and any(h is handle for h in native.primitives.handles)
457:         attempt = port.lifecycle._interrupted_retirements.get(port.key)
458:         active = attempt is not None
459:         if active:
460:             assert type(attempt) is FLOW._InterruptedRetirement and attempt.native is native
461:             assert attempt.manager is port.lifecycle and attempt.delegate is port
462:             port.lifecycle._check_interrupted_attempt(attempt, "retiring")
463:         return {"api": name, "owner": label, "call_index": len(self.calls),
464:                 "manager_attempt_active_at_call": active}

466:     def interrupted_completion(self, port):
467:         # The manager has already removed its active attempt. Revalidate the
468:         # retained witness using the explicit released-stage predicate only.
469:         assert port is self.interrupted_port and type(port) is FLOW.GeneratedLifecyclePort
470:         probe, witness = port._interrupted_probe, port._interrupted_witness
471:         assert type(probe) is FLOW._InterruptedOperationProbe
472:         assert type(witness) is FLOW._InterruptedRetirementWitness
473:         attempt, native = witness.attempt, witness.native
474:         assert attempt.probe is probe and native is probe.native and probe.manager_attempt is attempt
475:         port.lifecycle._check_interrupted_attempt(attempt, "released")
476:         FLOW._require_interrupted_witness(attempt, witness)
477:         assert port.key not in port.lifecycle._interrupted_retirements
478:         assert native.pair.forced_stop_attempted is True
479:         assert witness.child_native_exit == 1 and witness.job_active_processes == 0
480:         return {"retained_witness_current_at_completion": True,
481:                 "active_manager_attempt_absent_at_completion": True,
482:                 "same_manager_owner_token_permit_delegate": True,
483:                 "aggregate_quarantine_history_retained": True,
484:                 "all_individual_handles_confirmed_closed": True,
485:                 "retained_handle_count": len(native.handle_states),
486:                 "owner_closed_and_revoked": probe.owner._closed_verified and probe.owner._revoked,
487:                 "token_still_revoked": probe.token.revoked,
488:                 "post_quarantine_revision": probe.quarantine_revision,
489:                 "pre_interruption_revision": probe.revision,
490:                 "token_revision_at_completion": probe.token.revision,
491:                 "quarantine_head": probe.quarantine_head,
492:                 "quarantine_sha256": hashlib.sha256(probe.quarantine_raw).hexdigest(),
493:                 "close_head": probe.close_head,
494:                 "primary_stop_latch_consumed": native.pair.forced_stop_attempted,
495:                 "primary_process_wait_observed": witness.process_wait_observed,
496:                 "primary_native_exit": witness.child_native_exit,
497:                 "primary_job_active_processes": witness.job_active_processes,
498:                 "native_events": list(self.interrupted_events),

502:     def _cleanup_scope(self, name, args, now):
503:         if self.cleanup_started is None:
504:             self.cleanup_started = now
505:         assert now - self.cleanup_started <= 10 and len(self.cleanup_calls) < 64, "reserved_cleanup_budget"
506:         p = self.primitives
507:         assert p is not None and args, "cleanup_requires_exact_owner"
508:         value = args[0]
509:         live = [handle for handle in p.handles if handle.value == value and not handle.closed and not handle.unconfirmed]
510:         assert len(live) == 1, "cleanup_handle_not_exactly_owned"
511:         if name == "TerminateJobObject":
512:             assert ROLE == "controller" and any(worker.job is live[0] for worker in p.workers), "cleanup_job_owner"
513:             assert args[1] == 1, "fixed_cleanup_exit"
514:         elif name == "TerminateProcess":
515:             assert ROLE == "controller" and any(worker.process is live[0] for worker in p.workers), "cleanup_process_owner"
516:             assert args[1] == 1, "fixed_cleanup_exit"
517:         elif name == "WaitForSingleObject":
518:             assert type(args[1]) is int and 0 <= args[1] <= 5000, "bounded_cleanup_wait"
519:             assert live[0].kind == "ipc-event" or any(worker.process is live[0] for worker in p.workers), "cleanup_wait_owner"
520:             remaining_ms = int((10 - (now - self.cleanup_started)) * 1000)
521:             assert remaining_ms > 0, "cleanup_wait_budget_exhausted"
522:             effective = min(args[1], remaining_ms)
523:             self.cleanup_wait_caps.append({"requested_ms": args[1], "effective_ms": effective})
524:             args = (args[0], effective)
525:         elif name in ("CancelIoEx", "GetOverlappedResult"):
526:             assert live[0].kind in ("ipc-server", "ipc-client", "ipc-inherited-client"), "cleanup_pipe_owner"
527:             if name == "GetOverlappedResult":
528:                 assert len(args) == 4 and args[3] == 0, "cleanup_result_must_not_block"
529:         elif name == "CloseHandle":
530:             assert live[0].kind == "ipc-event", "only_completed_event_closure_in_reserved_cleanup"
531:         else:
532:             raise RuntimeError("Work budget closed; operation is outside reserved cleanup")
533:         self.cleanup_calls.append(name)
534:         return args
